about: The Workbench icons of the Ceferino drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's own icon (data/ima/icono.png, GPL 2 or later). Ceferino-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Ceferino.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for upstream's README and the licence; Folder.info for data.
